dedupe_keys.name: odyssee mure energy efficiency indicators and policy measures databases for eu countries switzerland and energy community parties

description: ODYSSEE-MURE is a long-running European monitoring project built on two complementary databases. ODYSSEE holds detailed energy efficiency and CO2 indicators, with energy consumption by end use, the drivers behind it such as activity indicators, and related emissions for industry, transport and buildings. MURE holds quantitative and qualitative information on energy efficiency policies and measures implemented at EU or national level. The project page describes a 30-year history and coverage of all 27 EU Member States, the EU as a whole, Switzerland and the Energy Community Contracting Parties (Albania, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Georgia, Kosovo, North Macedonia, Moldova, Montenegro, Serbia and Ukraine); the 2025 to 2027 phase supports monitoring of the recast Energy Efficiency Directive. Technical coordination is by Enerdata, Fraunhofer ISI and IEECP with a national partner agency in each country. The indicator site offers the full database, key indicators and facilities for market diffusion, decomposition, CO2 decomposition, comparison and energy saving, all shown as last updated September 2026; policy tools query the MURE measures. Access: the indicator site states that the full database is restricted, while the other data tools are publicly available online, alongside country and sectoral profiles and policy briefs. Caveats: licence terms are not given on the pages read, and indicators are national aggregates, not asset data. Simulation uses are end-use demand baselines and efficiency trends for long-term energy demand and planning scenarios.
